main: ACTIVITY 1 (Silent reading – 7 min): Learners read a news article for children individually; teacher listens to 2-3 learners read aloud in turn.

plenary: 2-3 learners share their favourite part with the class.
Teacher displays the reading log and praises consistent readers.
Homework: read one page to a family member and retell it.
Encourage learners to borrow a book for the week.
